steps.instruction: Gradually stir 4 tablespoons of cold water into 2 1/2 tablespoons of bread flour.
steps.spoken: Gradually stir 4 tablespoons of cold water into 2 1/2 tablespoons of bread flour, until you have a smooth, thin paste.

steps.instruction: Add the paste to 1 pint of scalded milk, stirring until thickened.
Cover the pot and cook for 20 minutes.
Add 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 2 tablespoons of butter in small pieces.
Dip each of the 6 slices of dry toast in the sauce until soft.
Move the soft toast to a serving dish.
Pour the rest of the sauce over the toast.
